page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top; page number at top left. Heading "DE AGNVS DEI CONFECTIONE & benedictione" centred below the first paragraph. No marginal notes. Catchword and signature absent.

main_text.p: lumen indeficiens, conditor omnium luminum, exaudi nos famulos tuos, & benedic hunc ignem, qui tua sanctificatione atque benedictione consecretur, tu, qui illuminas omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum, illumina tenebras cordis nostri, & conscientias nostras igne tuae charitatis, ut tuo lumine igniti, tuo lumine illuminati, expulsis a cordibus nostris peccatorum tenebris, ad vitam te illustrante pervenire mereamur aeternam.
main_text.head: DE AGNVS DEI CONFECTIONE & benedictione.
main_text.p: Ad aquam: Domine Deus pater omnipotens, fabricator elementorum omnium, & conservator humani generis, datorque gratiae spiritualis, & largitor salutis aeternae, qui aquas ex Paradiso fonte manantes totam terram irrigare iussisti, super quas unigenitus tuus vestigiis pedibus ambulavit, & in sis baptizari dignatus est, quae una cum suo sanguine de latere sacratissimo profluxerunt, & baptizari in eis praecepit discipulis omnes gentes, adesto benignus & clemens, & nobis tua haec magnalia recolentibus adveniat, ut ea, quae in hoc aquarum vasculo ad gloriam tui nominis praeparato infundere decrevimus & immergere, benedicas, & benedicta sanctifica

page.notes: Some words in the heading and first lines are in black letter or heavily worn; readings such as "tuo lumine" and "sanctifica" at the line end are uncertain. The final word is cut off by the page edge and is marked as a fragment; a faint mark at the bottom is not transcribed.
